limitations.title: ESP has no flow affinity
limitations.detail: GEMINI's ESP scales head by (f/60)² and power by (f/60)³ at the same flow but has no flow affinity, so its curve power is optimistic at reduced frequency (SUB-ESP).
limitations.impact: ESP curve power is approximate at part load.
limitations.mitigation: Plant power uses the DB-13/DB-40 rule QΔp/0.70; the curve power is a comparison only.

limitations.title: Constant brine PVT
limitations.detail: ρ, μ, c_p constant (DB-08/DB-33); no μ(T), so cold-injection injectivity is not lowered (II = PI, SUB-II); cold injection adds about +6 bar on the 26.5 bar(g) injection WHP.
limitations.impact: Injection pressure and pump power underestimated at the injector.
limitations.mitigation: WP-11 SUB-II sensitivity; report injection WHP with the cold-injection note.

limitations.title: Steady wellbore heat loss
limitations.detail: Steady U = 10 W/m²K: wellhead 77.1 °C at 50 m³/h versus about 81–83 °C transient.
limitations.impact: Low-flow wellhead temperature is conservative (heat underestimated).
limitations.mitigation: State as conservative; transient wellbore model out of scope.

limitations.title: ESP motor heating not modelled
limitations.detail: Motor/pump losses heat the brine by about 0.4 K; not added to the wellhead temperature.
limitations.impact: Wellhead temperature slightly underestimated.
limitations.mitigation: None needed (conservative).

limitations.title: No fracture-pressure limit
limitations.detail: Injection wellhead pressure is not checked against a formation fracture pressure.
limitations.impact: A high-rate injection point could exceed a fracture limit unnoticed.
limitations.mitigation: Ask for the fracture gradient (request_missing_input) before final sizing.

limitations.title: No flashing check above 100 °C
limitations.detail: Brine above 100 °C (C4: 108 °C reservoir at 3.2 km, DB-29) is not checked for flashing in the surface letdown; CFG-SURFACE only flags brine above 100 °C.
limitations.impact: Deep-concept surface pressures may be optimistic.
limitations.mitigation: Keep the surface loop pressurised above saturation; flag C4 in the report.

limitations.title: ESP far from BEP at minimum flow
limitations.detail: At 50 m³/h the ESP runs at Q/(Q_BEP·f/60) 0.33 (TL-05 esp_flow_to_bep_ratio), outside the preferred operating range.
limitations.impact: Minimum-flow efficiency and pump life uncertain.
limitations.mitigation: Prefer turndown by switching doublets; note in DR-01.

limitations.title: Standalone esp type is water-only
limitations.detail: The registry type 'esp' is GEMINI's water ESP: head and power are not scaled by the brine specific gravity (the producer ESP is, via well_flow._FluidESP; brine ESP Δp and power × 1.03).
limitations.impact: A project using 'esp' directly underestimates brine pump Δp and power.
limitations.mitigation: Use producer_well (the generator does); scale 'esp' by the pvt SG if it is ever used.

limitations.title: No storage component in the plant generator
limitations.detail: C6 runs as its parent plant; the HT-ATES outlet temperature is not modelled and recovered heat below 100 °C would need a booster heat pump.
limitations.impact: C6 benefit rests on dispatch bookkeeping (STO-REC-HT), not a simulated storage loop.
limitations.mitigation: Report C6 as indicative; booster HP not sized.

limitations.title: Heat-pump fouling not modelled
limitations.detail: The closed-form Lorenz heat pump has no fouling factor on evaporator or condenser.
limitations.impact: COP slightly optimistic over the plant life.
limitations.mitigation: Covered by the VER-HP-ETA cap and WP-11 sensitivity.

limitations.title: HEX imprecise for balanced flows
limitations.detail: The GEMINI ε-NTU rating model is imprecise as C_r → 1.
limitations.impact: Balanced-flow HEX duty has a small error.
limitations.mitigation: CFG-HEX sizes UA by inverting RC-03 eq 1 at the design point.

limitations.title: HEX temperature difference uses abs()
limitations.detail: The GEMINI HEX uses abs(T_s,in − T_p,in): a colder primary gives heat in the wrong direction instead of zero duty.
limitations.impact: A mis-wired or off-design HEX can report positive duty.
limitations.mitigation: Generator wires brine hot side only; verifier first-law check (PH-22).

limitations.title: No absorption isolation loop
limitations.detail: Brine drives the absorption generator directly (titanium tubes, RC-05); the isolation HEX of spec §3.4 is not modelled.
limitations.impact: Drive temperature optimistic by one HEX approach.
limitations.mitigation: Note in DR-04; WP-11 sensitivity on drive temperature.

limitations.title: GEMINI Compressor omits k and drive losses
limitations.detail: Compressor power omits the isentropic exponent k (about 1.3, power low) and the motor and drive efficiencies 0.93 × 0.97.
limitations.impact: Unused by the plant; would underestimate power if used.
limitations.mitigation: If used: fix behind a parameter and add REFERENCE.md.

limitations.title: Private well_flow helpers used as API
limitations.detail: tools/doublet.py calls gemini_simulator.well_flow._build_dpdt and _build_esp.
limitations.impact: Renaming them breaks TL-05/TL-06.
limitations.mitigation: Treat both as API; this analysis checks they exist.
